notes.title: Update And Melee Weapon Will Add Soon
notes.notes:
1. Map mark feature added, you can mark the scene you like.

2. The mark of the current scene always points home, you can find the way home easily.

3. Adjust some parameters, such as eat ingredients raw can restore your status better than before.

4. Fix some bugs, and optimized some details.

5. Melee weapons are coming soon.

notes.title: Big Update – the game is not that hard now
notes.notes:
1. Add difficulty option. You can enjoy the game in the easy mode now. If you think you’re prepared, you can challenge the hardcore mode.

2. Add some graphic option. Now Anti-Aliasing is a choice.

3. Adjust the balance of the game. Take care of the guns, they’re more dangerous now.
